Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in S.T. Case No.42/47 of 2021 pending in the Court of learned Adhoc Addl. District & Sessions Judge (FTSC), Bhadrak, arising out of Agarpada P.S. Case No.70 of 2021 for commission of the alleged offence under Section 376(2)(n)(L) IPC.
3.

Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Special Judge (FTSC), Bhadrak by order dated 18.07.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 10.03.2021 and because of non-progress in trial, he seeks release.

5. Taking note of the grievance of the Petitioner that the trial was getting protracted, a report was called for and the status report of the learned Court in seisin dated 03.11.2023 is extracted hereunder:
xxx xxx xxx

"With due respect, I am submitting herewith the detail report regarding stage of trial of S.T. Case No. 42/47 of 2021 as called for by the Hon'ble Court as per the court's order no. 01 did.
16.10.2023 passed in BLAPL No. 11175/2023.

sentences.text: That G.R. Case No. 705/2021 was committed to the court of Sessions Judge Bhadrak, on 26.08.2021 which was registered as S.T. Case No: 42/47 of 2021.
The said case was received on transfer by this court on 21.09.2021.
Charge was framed on 08.10.2021 and the case was posted to 10.11.2021 for hearing.
In spite of repeated summons, the charge-sheeted witnesses did not turn up till 29.11.2022.
On 29.11.2022 the informant was examined as P.W. 1.
But the learned defence counsel did not turn up to cross-examine the said witness in spite of repeated call.
So, the case was adjourned to 23.12.2022 for hearing.
On 08.09.2023 another witness was present.
She was examined as P.W.2.
But the learned defence counsel did not turn up to cross-examined the said witness in spite of repeated call.
So, the case was adjourned to 06.10.2023 for hearing.
On verification of case record it is found that the orders have been complied and summons have been issued to the witnesses.
Now the case is posted to 06.11.2023 for hearing.

Further I am to submit that in BLAPI. No. 10969/2022 in order did. 27.01.2023 the fixation of time limit has not been brought to the notice of this court for conclusion of trial of the case within a period of six months.
This is for your kind information and necessary action."
xxx xxx xxx 6.

It is apt to note here that earlier this Court by order dated 27.01.2023 in BLAPL No.10969 of 2022 has directed the learned Court in seisin to conclude the trial within a period of six months from the date of receipt/production of the certified copy of the said order and the same was not brought to the it's notice, as evident from the report extracted hereinabove.
7.

Taking into account the period in custody, learned Court in seisin is called upon to conclude the trial on day-to-day basis within a period of three months hence, failing which liberty is granted to the Petitioner to renew his prayer before the learned Court in seisin afresh.
8. Registry is requested to communicate this order.
9. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
10. This Court by order dated 27.01.2023 directed the trial to be concluded within six months.

Paragraph-9 of the said order is extracted hereunder for convenience of ready reference:-
"As the Petitioner is stated to be in custody since 09.03.2021, learned Court in seisin is called upon to expedite the trial and conclude the same within the period of six months from the date of receipt/production of the copy of this order."
11.
It is revealed from the record of the Registry that the said order was not communicated till 04.07.2023 and there is no plausible explanation for such non communication.
Ex-facie, by their lackadaisical attitude the concerned Superintendent and the Dealing Assistant have rendered the order passed by this Court nugatory.
Such conduct by the Officials of the Registry can never be Ghunga Jena @ Gangadhar vs State Of Odisha ....
